title: 𣿅国陆地推演地形
mountainConnectionPolicy: 瑞丰山脉沿河60西侧从剑山经雪瑞峰延伸，并顺河道弯折方向渐隐；中央山脉不绘制贯穿式骨架，由彼此留有山口的局部山群组成，西南盆地的春分山、梅花山、旃檀山仅轻微搭接，中央山脉最北端为刺梨山。长岭山脉从鹞岳沿河道U形弯折绕过河谷，在北侧鞍部与对岸山体自然接合；河道通过曲线峡谷塑形，不再用直线河岸切断山体。长岭市位于山间河谷，塔马市按山城保留。
namedPeakPolicy: All 87 labelled summit heights in data/mountain_peaks.js are exact interpolation constraints; relief-only position and zone corrections are stored in a separate copy, leaving the original source file untouched.
peakAnchorKernel: Named ridge peaks use range-aligned anisotropic kernels; Central Range peaks use independent local orientations, with only the three southwest-basin massifs allowed mild overlap. Nearby mapped rivers carve smooth curved valleys from the actual watercourse; no planar bank mask truncates mountain massifs.

riverWaterSurfacePolicy.sourceMapWaterInk: #b1d0ed pixels from the official 4x map raster, intersected with the land mask and excluding lakes and ocean
riverWaterSurfacePolicy.inlandWaterSurfaceRule: Channel surfaces are constrained on the connected river-pixel graph from headwaters toward sea/lake/sinks, never rising downstream; local bank minima keep the water below adjacent land.

flowConditioning.method: Eight-neighbour graph over the union of all official blue river-stroke pixels and 300 traced vector reaches; route connected water pixels to sea/lake/inland sinks and propagate downstream height limits across the full network.

riverWaterSurfacePolicy.curvedRiverValleyPolicy: Terrain caps follow the curved union of traced channels and official water strokes. The high-relief side-slope cap contracts to about 17px at the outer edge while lowland floodplains retain their broader 28px influence; no straight bank-plane cuts are applied.
riverWaterSurfacePolicy.description: All official blue water-stroke pixels use the downhill-conditioned surface; the river graph is reconditioned against final banks after valley carving.

riverMountainAudit.method: For each labelled summit, compare its nearest official blue water pixel with terrain 8px on both sides after the curved channel valley has been carved; the check records no straight bank clipping.

hydrologyTileAudit.grid: 8 columns x 6 rows, 280x258 source-pixel windows with 20-26px overlap

riverFlowAudit.directionRule: Each traced reach is checked along adjacent 8-connected centerline pixels within the complete water graph; sparse geometry vertices are not compared across branches.

specialRifengRiverAlignment.bankMask: traced unlooped river-60 trunk profile, then continued to the bend crossing on the map-west side
specialRifengRiverAlignment.description: The ridge bends along river 60's western bank from 剑山 to 雪瑞峰 and tapers in the downstream bend direction, avoiding a horizontal cut across the terrain.

specialCentralRangeLayout.description: No point-to-point Central Range backbone is drawn. Local massifs are kept separate by natural passes, with only slight overlap in the southwest-basin cluster; the range terminates at 刺梨山.

specialSouthwestBasinMountainBlend.description: Three nearby southwest-basin peaks receive modestly broader, differently oriented forms and a low shared shoulder so their lower slopes touch lightly without joining the whole Central Range.

specialNorthPlateauEasternSpur.description: A restrained plateau shoulder supports the three mapped eastern peaks without drawing a continuous Central Range backbone through them.

specialBaisuiIslandPeak.description: The relief-copy summit marker is moved from offshore onto the mapped island interior; original mountain peak data remain unchanged.

smallIslandElevationPolicy.labelledIslandSummitPolicy: Summit heights stay exact in the click readout and are concentrated in a 1.1–2.6 px local cone; surrounding island terrain falls rapidly toward the shore.

northernPlateauCoastalPolicy.description: Nearshore terrain of the northern plateau is lowered modestly while preserving the sharp coastal escarpment and exact summit cores.

specialLonglingRiverValley.description: The river segment south of 长岭市 is lowered into a continuous valley; the city sits on a valley floor just above the channel. Its local trough follows the shortest land path to the mapped river bend.

specialTamadMountainCity.description: Tamad remains a high-elevation mountain city as explicitly requested.

specialSwordCityValley.description: A narrow, steep-sided mountain-foot settlement valley joins the nearby river and preserves mapped summit points.

specialNearbyRiverGorge.description: A narrow gorge follows mapped river 231 through the saddle between nearby peaks, interrupting the unsupported mountain connection while preserving summit anchors.

boundaryDivideSegments.reason: A subtle interior divide between two cities, well away from mapped rivers and settlements.
A low, rounded boundary hill on an existing local crest, separated from rivers, coasts, and settlements.

unnamedLowReliefHills.description: Seeded broad swells and sparse irregular low knolls add unnamed relief to the plateau and selected central plain patches. Two short, fixed-seed ridges reinforce only boundary sections that already sit on local divides; the full city borders are not raised. City sites, mapped summit cores, river channels, coast strips, and mapped mountain backbones remain clear; the main plain stays below 20 m except for a small number of low hummocks.

specialSeaBottomLakeBasin.description: The mapped lake floor stays near -200 m with fixed-seed non-integer relief; dry land around the shore rises gently above the river surface.

elevationScalePolicy: The raster scale expands to 1.4 times the highest mapped peak; no Earth-based maximum elevation is imposed.
plateauEdgeStyle: Irregular steep escarpment with river-cut passes and rapid relief change at the official northern-plateau boundary.
coastalElevationPolicy: Non-mountain coast terrain includes a varied 0–4 m strip at the shore, rising gently inland and staying below 50 m by about 20 source pixels; northern plateau nearshore relief is capped separately while retaining a steep escarpment.
easternLowlandPolicy: Non-mountain terrain in the east and southeast remains below 50 m; the first 20 source pixels from shore taper gently from near sea level to below 50 m.
plainElevationPolicy: Most non-mountain terrain in the mapped central plain remains below 20 m with broad low-amplitude undulation; sparse seeded, unnamed low hummocks are the limited exceptions, with no quantized elevation tiers.
fineReliefDetail: Fixed-seed, low-amplitude multiscale terrain detail; two short pre-existing city-divide sections receive tapered low ridges, while all other borders follow the terrain without artificial elevation. Slope-based lighting keeps low hills legible at map zoom without drawing contours.
elevationRaster: data/relief_elevation.js; full-resolution 16-bit elevation with official river-water mask and flow-conditioned river surfaces; retained as terrain-model and hydrology-audit data
elevationSampleImage: data/relief_elevation.png; 16-bit click-sampling image with alpha mask excluding rivers and open water, retained lakes include basin-floor elevations
sources: data/relief_mountain_peaks.js (relief-copy peak positions and northern-plateau extension classification)
Administrative-Division-Map-of-Donh-2026.png (official labelled map; green dashed northern plateau boundary digitized in source pixels)
limits: The source map has no surveyed elevation raster. All displayed peak heights are honored exactly; terrain between mapped control points and city heights remain a fixed geographic model based on relief, drainage, coastlines, and map context.

cityLocationAudit.basis: visible SVG city-dot centers in index.html; city label anchors retained separately

cityRelationshipAudit.method: Each city was sampled at its visible map marker; checked against land mask, the complete official river-pixel network, nearest named summit, and a 12px neighborhood elevation range.
